about_the_game:
Step into the world of potion-making, where every brew is a mix of magic, mystery, and just a little bit of chaos. Learn from your father’s cryptic notes, experiment with mystical ingredients, and cast spells to refine your craft, all while keeping up with the endless demands of your quirky customers.

🔮 Master the Unpredictable - Every potion is a puzzle! Discover recipes, mix enchanted ingredients, and deal with unexpected reactions.

✨ Spellcasting & Dual-Potion System - Magic isn’t just for show! Manipulate ingredients, combine effects, and experiment with alchemy like never before.

📖 The Language of Magic - Learn and translate Runetrian, an ancient magical script, to uncover powerful spells, understand ancient recipes, and refine your craft.

😼 Your "Helpful" Feline Assistant - Astrid, the talking cat, will either guide you or roast your potion-making skills into hell and back.

⏱️ A Race Against Time - Customers won’t wait forever! Balance speed and precision in Rue's Tale (Story Mode), or push your limits in Endless Mode.

⚖️ Customers with Opinions - Some adore your work, others… not so much. Keep them happy, or prepare for some dangerous consequences!

👗 Sense of Style - Decorate how you play the game with Outfits, and maybe even make it look less like a magical disaster zone.

🌍 Explore Gilderia - As you delve into Rue's Tale, meet Gilderia's quirky citizens, and uncover secrets hidden in magic and history.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 3200U (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel UHD 620 / AMD Radeon Vega 3) or DX11-capable discrete GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Brew potions, cast spells, and master alchemy in a fast-paced potion shop where magic and language intertwine. Experiment with weird ingredients, and manage quirky customers while avoiding failures! Every potion is a puzzle, but will you perfect your craft or turn your shop into a disaster zone?
supported_languages:
English*, Arabic, Italian
*languages with full audio support
